messages:
Alex: Heads-up 1: we got interest from the hardware partner to bundle our LangChain + LlamaIndex gateway adapter into their marketplace SKU. Need owners and a quick plan.
Priya: I can own the adapter spec + tests. target: v0 in 2 weeks if eng can commit to basic read/write + embeddings.
Diego: Eng can do v0 in 2w for core flows. request: clear sample corpus and an example orchestrator flow (retrieve -> rerank -> summarize).
Alex: Design + marketing? we need a 1-min demo GIF and one landing screenshot. @DesignBot can you produce assets once demo notebook ready?
DesignBot: Yep. Will queue GIF + screenshots. Need notebook by EOD + high-res logo + brand color hex.
Priya: Mini invocation example for demos:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/gateway/adapter \n -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \n -d '{"flow":"kb-rerank-summary","source":"lindex://kb-123","max_tokens":120}'
```
Diego: I'll spin a perf run on the A10x2 nodes next Monday 1. ETA 3 business days for throughput baseline.
MarketplaceBot: Marketplace checklist: publisher contract, security attestation, asset pack (icons, screenshots), pricing mapping, support contact. Manifest due 10 business days before publish.
Alex: Owners: Adapter = @Priya, Perf & infra = @Diego, Assets = @DesignBot, Marketplace/legal = @Alex.
Priya: I'll open the PR and tag QA. plan: PR in 9 working days, QA 3 days, perf 3 days, assets 3 days, manifest + legal 5 days. external announce ~4 weeks.
Diego: :white_check_mark: perf job queued. linking the perf job id when done.
DesignBot: :eyes: will start once notebook link posted.
Alex: Good. Weekly 10-min sync Friday until publish. I'll drop a calendar invite. Thanks everyone!
